rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child. Both are January 1961 Cabinet-resignation letters that open by praising the secretary's departmental leadership, accept the resignation effective January 20, 1961, commend the secretary and staff, summarize selected departmental accomplishments with reference to a report, and close with appreciation plus wishes for health and happiness upon leaving government service. C10 and C02 share much of this contemporary resignation-letter structure, but C06 has the closest sequence and phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Labor, as of January 20, 1961, I express my high regard for you and your capable staff.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In accepting your resignation as Secretary of Commerce, effective January 20, 1961, I take the opportunity to pay tribute to you and your excellent staff.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical operative sentence, with the office, preposition, and praise wording adapted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Important new programs and administrative and structural changes have been initiated in the Department, as your report indicates.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Among the many significant accomplishments of your Department these past eight years, two deserve special mention... As you point out in your report
shared_material.explanation: Both pivot from general praise to report-based discussion of selected departmental programs and accomplishments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As you return to private life, you carry with you my deep appreciation for a job admirably done. May your future years bring good health and much happiness.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For these activities, as well as the broad range of other functions you have supervised, you have my appreciation and thanks. As you leave government service, I wish you health and happiness in the years to come.
shared_material.explanation: The closings use the same sequence: appreciation, departure from government, and wishes for future health and happiness.
